name: health
title: Application health
description: Return the current local Jobniac health envelope.

GeneratedResumeCleanup.description: Public shape for observed generated-output cleanup health.
GeneratedResumeCleanup.title: GeneratedResumeCleanup

HealthMetadata.description: Public metadata shape preserved from the health use case.
HealthMetadata.title: HealthMetadata

outputSchema.description: Stable structured result returned by the ``health`` MCP tool.

name: list_profiles
title: List profiles
description: List a bounded page of profile identities without returning raw resume text or private credentials.

outputSchema.description: Stable structured page envelope returned by ``list_profiles``.
outputSchema.title: ProfileListResponse

name: get_profile
description: Get a normalized profile aggregate by profile UUID.

name: create_profile
description: Create a normalized profile aggregate and return the persisted profile graph.

name: update_profile
description: Replace a normalized profile aggregate using its latest revision.

name: update_profile_project
description: Partially update one profile project using the current profile revision; omitted fields are preserved and supplied technologies replace that project technologies.

name: search_profiles
description: Search normalized profile fields with bounded deterministic ranking.

name: search_jobs
description: Search stored jobs using bounded indexed terms and deterministic ranking.

name: update_job
description: Partially update a stored job using its expected revision. Omitted or null fields preserve existing values; provided skills replace existing skills.

name: list_jobs
description: List a bounded page of stored job postings.

name: get_job
description: Get a stored job aggregate by UUID, including source provenance.

name: add_job_from_text
description: Insert a job from pasted text with idempotent source tracking.

name: analyze_job_match
description: Create or reuse an immutable deterministic profile-to-job match report.

name: analyze_all_job_matches
description: Analyze one bounded page of jobs; pair failures do not stop the page.

name: get_match_report
description: Get an immutable report with current source-revision staleness.

name: list_match_reports
description: List one bounded page of reports with optional profile and job filters.

name: submit_match_review
description: Persist a separate advisory review and deduplicated divergence disagreement.

name: get_match_review
description: Get one immutable advisory review.

name: list_match_reviews
description: List one bounded page of advisory reviews.

name: list_match_disagreements
description: List one bounded page of disagreements.

name: acknowledge_match_disagreement
description: Acknowledge a disagreement with an optional existing issue reference.

name: link_match_disagreement
description: Link a disagreement to an existing issue without contacting its provider.

name: store_document_file
description: Store an allowed local PDF in the local database and return metadata only.

name: get_document_metadata
description: Get stored document metadata by UUID without returning original bytes.

name: extract_pdf_text
description: Preview bounded local PDF text as untrusted data without storing it.

name: extract_stored_pdf_text
description: Extract bounded text from a stored PDF, optionally persisting provenance.

name: ingest_profile_from_stored_pdf
description: Populate the normalized profile schema from a stored PDF extraction and link the profile to that extraction.

name: get_profile_pdf_source
description: Get the one-to-one PDF extraction source link for a profile.

name: generate_pdf_file
description: Generate a standalone stored PDF and return committed file metadata.

name: generate_pdf_resume
description: Generate and link the current profile master resume PDF.

name: generate_canadian_pdf_resume
description: Generate and link the current Canadian profile resume PDF.

name: generate_canadian_french_pdf_resume
description: Generate and link the current French Canadian profile resume PDF.

name: generate_german_tailored_resume
description: Generate the current job-specific English and German resume variants.

name: generate_german_cover_letter
description: Generate a German cover letter for the exact selected current resume.

name: scan_arbeitnow_jobs
description: Read-only scan of the Arbeitnow public job-board API. Results are mutable and are not a snapshot.

name: import_arbeitnow_job
description: Import one signed, short-lived Arbeitnow scan candidate without refetching it.
